title: Telemetry bridge: anomaly context enrichment and noise suppression
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Background: The Console alert stream for usage/cost/latency is noisy during bursty customer behavior and cross-tenant correlated events. Current rules generate duplicate alerts across different detectors and surface signals without tenant/context enrichment (e.g., active features, rollout state, recent model/route changes). Goal: Build a lightweight "telemetry bridge" service in the backend pipeline that enriches anomaly signals with contextual metadata, computes an exposure-weighted suppression score, and deduplicates/re-weights alerts before they hit the incidenting pipeline and UI.
acceptance_criteria: A telemetry bridge service ingests anomaly candidates from the usage aggregator and outputs a single deduplicated alert per correlated event (for typical correlated bursts, reduce duplicate alerts by >=50%)
Each alert includes context fields: affected_tenant_segment, active_routes, recent_model_rollout_id, peak_window_percentile, and an exposure_score (0-1)
Adaptive suppression logic reduces false positives from low-exposure tenants while preserving high-exposure outages (no more than 5% false suppression on historical labeled incidents)
New pipeline stages instrumented with tracing and metrics (ingest rate, dedupe rate, suppressed_count, latency_ms) and visible in Console-Observability dashboards
End-to-end tests and canary rollout completed, with opt-out flag for tenants and a fallback to previous alerting behavior
tasks: Design telemetry bridge API and proto (supporting batched anomaly candidates)
Implement ingestion adapter in usage analytics pipeline (Kafka topic -> bridge) with idempotency keys
Add enrichment connectors: tenant metadata store, rollout service, route config cache
Develop exposure_weight function and tuning harness using historical usage traces
Implement deduplication / fingerprinting (temporal window + metric hash + affected route set similarity)
Add observability: Grafana panels + tracing spans + SLO alerts for bridge latency > 200ms
Create e2e test harness using replay datasets and recorded incidents
Run canary on 5% of tenant traffic; collect metrics and feedback; iterate on thresholds
Document runbook and CLI to toggle suppression/thresholds per workspace
comments: 2025-02-26: Kickoff - scoped to usage/cost/latency detectors first. Marcus to prototype exposure_weight offline this week. - Aisha

2025-03-02: Engineering note - initial dedupe strategy using min-hash on route sets showed good precision but misses temporal drift; switching to time-windowed clustering + hash signature. Need a small state store (Redis) for recent fingerprints. - Marcus

2025-03-04: Security review preliminary: enrichment queries only read tenant metadata and rollout IDs, no customer PII. Ops asked to confirm audit log retention for suppressed alerts. - Priya (Security)

2025-03-05: Prototype metrics: when running replay of Jan 2025 spike, duplicate alert count dropped 64% and suppressed alerts were predominantly low-exposure tenants. Preparing PR and benchmark artifacts. - Marcus
